summary: Sets out requirements for protocols that detect lost packets using timers, the only way to be sure a packet is lost when no confirmation arrives. It exists because each protocol implementation tends to reinvent its time-based logic, sometimes badly, and this gives guidance on doing it well. It is a Best Current Practice.

eli5.summary: If a letter has not been confirmed after a while, you assume it got lost. This explains how to pick a sensible waiting time, not too short and not too long.

questions: how long to wait before declaring packet loss
requirements for time based loss detection
